quote: Just as a blind man might find a jewel amongst heaps of rubbish, so this Spirit of Awakening has somehow arisen in me.
source: Shantideva, A Guide to the Bodhisattva Way of Life, chapter 3, verse 27 (trans. Vesna A. Wallace and B. Alan Wallace, 1997)

evidence.where: a PDF of the Wallace translation (Snow Lion, 1997, copyright page and ISBN 1-55939-061-1 present), extracted with pdftotext and read in chapter III
evidence.edition: Santideva, A Guide to the Bodhisattva Way of Life, trans. Vesna A. Wallace and B. Alan Wallace, Snow Lion Publications, Ithaca, 1997
evidence.locator: Chapter III, Adopting the Spirit of Awakening, verse 27, p. 35

reason: Verse III.27 in the Wallace text reads exactly as proposed; the edition sets each verse as a prose paragraph, so no lineation is lost. A named-author treatise, in scope as Shantideva was in February with a different translation. Not shipped, nothing near, Shantideva at 1 of 3, not banned.
